'''Kristal Skull''' was a building in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. It was decorated with a large [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] marquee, which stated the name of the establishment.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name is an obvious reference to another [[Lucasfilm]] project, [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull|''Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull'']].
